top_signals.title: Asian Stocks and Bonds Rise After Treasuries Rally: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks and bonds gained as US plans to buy back longer-dated Treasuries to curb borrowing costs buoyed sentiment. The dollar steadied after sliding to a three-month low.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
